title: Software Development Engineer, Amazon Fulfillment Technology (AFT), Platform Engineering and Services
description:
**Description**
Amazon Fulfillment Technologies (AFT) powers the physical engine at the heart of Amazon — magically turning your click of a button into packages at your door. Within AFT, the Labor Insights team builds and operates the platform that tracks on associate labor performance across Amazon's entire global warehouse network. Labor Insights' suite of 18+ services supports ~1 million associates and 70,000+ daily portal users across 9,800+ facilities and 10 business lines — ingesting over 19 billion labor events annually to produce the real-time productivity reports that warehouse managers rely on to run their operations every day. We leverage AWS technologies, stream processing, and AI/ML to build distributed, highly available systems that operate at massive scale.
  
  
Are you ready for a challenge? As a Software Development Engineer on the Labor Insights team, you will build the next generation of Amazon's labor management platform — designing systems that ingest billions of labor events from warehouse floor tools and time clock systems, aggregate them through multi-stage pipelines, and serve real-time productivity reports to operations managers across the globe. You will own design and development of distributed systems that refresh reports every 10–15 minutes across 3 global regions while maintaining 99.9% availability. You will contribute to a wide range of projects — from event processing pipelines and aggregation engines to reporting APIs, modern React-based portals, and AI-powered configuration tools. Most excitingly, you will help drive refresh of the existing tool, an AI-first greenfield initiative to rebuild the platform from the ground up using modern stream-based architecture, eliminating a decade of technical debt and delivering near real-time metrics. You will be involved in all aspects of the software development cycle including scoping, design, implementation, testing, and delivery. A commitment to teamwork, hustle, and strong communication skills are absolute requirements. Creating reliable, scalable, and high-performance services requires exceptional technical expertise. If you have that expertise, are customer-centric, and motivated about building systems that operate at global scale, then we want to talk to you!
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design, develop, and test software components across Labor Insights' ingestion, aggregation, reporting, and configuration layers — handling labor events, time clock punches, employee location tracking, and productivity report generation
* Build new services using AI-assisted development practices, leveraging tools like Amazon Q and Bedrock to achieve high-velocity delivery on greenfield systems
* Design large-scale data processing solutions using DynamoDB, PostgreSQL, S3, SQS/SNS, EventBridge, Lambda, and stream processing frameworks (Cosmos/Flink) optimized for high throughput and low-latency access
* Drive service consolidation and modernization — migrating from legacy infrastructure to Native AWS (NAWS) with full CI/CD pipelines
* Participate in definition of coding standards and apply them in code and design reviews
* Provide estimates for development tasks and negotiate timelines with project leaders
* Mentor junior team members and help them acquire critical skills and best practices
* Document and communicate technical concepts to team members and stakeholders
* Participate in deep technical discussions, where you stand up for your ideas and work with team members to find the best solution for the customer
* Identify technical and project risks and take initiative to mitigate them

A day in the life
  
  
Full-cycle ownership. You contribute to all aspects of the software development cycle — from scoping and design through implementation, testing, and delivery of features that provide labor performance visibility to Amazon's global fulfillment operations.
  
  
Billions-scale data processing. You build systems that ingest 19+ billion labor events per year from warehouse floor tools, time clock systems, and employee location heartbeats. You design multi-stage aggregation pipelines that process this data into PPR and PPA reports refreshed every 10–15 minutes, served to 70K+ daily users across 9,800+ facilities.
  
  
AWS-native architecture. You leverage the full AWS stack — DynamoDB for hot data storage, S3 for historical data, PostgreSQL for aggregated reports, SQS/SNS for event-driven processing, EventBridge and Lambda for serverless job orchestration, and Cosmos/Flink for stream processing. You architect for 99.9% availability across 3 global regions (NA, EU, FE).
  
  
AI-first development. You pioneer AI-assisted engineering practices — using Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Q, and AI-powered tools to accelerate greenfield development at 20X traditional velocity. You build intelligent systems like AI-powered configuration assistants, automated intake routing, and GenAI-driven operational tooling.
  
  
Modernization at scale. You modernize a 15+ year-old platform serving every fulfillment center worldwide — consolidating 23+ services into a clean microservices architecture, rebuilding the portal experience in React from legacy JSP/jQuery, and transitioning from batch to stream processing, all while maintaining zero-downtime operations.
  
  
**About The Team**
About Labor Insights: We build Amazon's global labor management platform — the system of record for measuring associate performance across every fulfillment center, sort center, delivery station, and grocery facility worldwide. Labor Insights tracks how ~1 million associates spend their time, producing the productivity reports (PPR, PPA, attendance, Time Off Task) that operations managers use to make staffing decisions, identify bottlenecks, and ensure customer shipments go out on time.
  
  
**What Makes This Role Exciting**

* Build FCLM 2.0 from the ground up — a once-in-a-career opportunity to greenfield a platform that runs Amazon's global workforce visibility, using AI-first development to deliver in months what would take years through traditional approaches
* Pioneer stream processing — transition from batch to real-time with sub-minute latencies using Cosmos/Flink, fundamentally changing how Amazon tracks labor performance
* Build a multi-tenant platform (FCLM FLEX) — design a configurable translation layer that recasts PPR and PPA as flexible views on the same underlying data, eliminating duplicate pipelines and enabling third-party teams to create custom labor views without engineering support
* Reimagine the portal experience — rebuild the portal used by 70K+ daily users from legacy JSP/jQuery into a modern React application with accessibility, localization, and scalable access controls
* Expand to new businesses — onboard Amazon Grocery (Fresh, Whole Foods) and other new business lines in 2026+, scaling the platform to new node types and labor models
* Build AI-powered tools — design intelligent systems using Amazon Bedrock for automated configuration management, request intake, and operational copilots that serve 1.5M workers globally

is the fastest growing healthcare technology company that builds products to make prescriptions accessible and affordable to everybody. Our two primary products – BlinkRx and Quick Save – remove traditional roadblocks within the current prescription supply chain, resulting in better access to critical medications and improved health outcomes for patients.

BlinkRx
is the world’s first pharma-to-patient cloud that offers a digital concierge service for patients who are prescribed branded medications. Patients benefit from transparent low prices, free home delivery, and world-class support on this first-of-its-kind centralized platform. With BlinkRx, never again will a patient show up at the pharmacy only to discover that they can’t afford their medication, their doctor needs to fill out a form for them, or the pharmacy doesn’t have the medication in stock.

We are a highly collaborative team of builders and operators who invent new ways of working in an industry that historically has resisted innovation. Join us!

**About the Role**

You are an engineer who, above all, is excited to build products that give our customers the best possible experience purchasing prescription medications. You have professional experience working on a team turning ideas into reliable, maintainable code — and ideally, you are eager to apply
**AI and machine learning**

**AWS, Python, Javascript, MySQL/Postgres, and Linux**

Through these partnerships, you’ll grow our business, build our core platform, and—above all—make sure that our customers have access to the least expensive and highest satisfaction pharmacy experience on earth.

* Our home delivery experience
* Our growth team
* Our core pharmacy platform

* Design new APIs to power innovative features
* Fix performance problems and debug production issues
* Perform peer code and architecture reviews
* Build new features, write unit tests, and lead the release of these features to production

  **ReactJS components**
  to improve our user experience
* **Design, build, deploy and use AI/ML solutions for telemedicine triage, prescription guidance, fraud detection, personalization, and operational automation**

**Good Owner — Be the CEO of your role**

* Help the team ship new products and features successfully with the right skills, mentorship, and organizational resources to deliver amazing experiences for our patients
* Coach, mentor, and develop engineers to reach individual goals while fostering cross-functional collaboration and product success
* Take responsibility for the long-term success of product projects and people
* **Champion responsible adoption of AI across engineering and product teams, ensuring solutions are ethical, reliable, and scalable**

**Good Learning — Learn something new every day**

* Demonstrate curiosity and an interest in learning new techniques and improving upon best practices to stay up-to-date with current and emerging trends
* Lead by example: put new ideas into action, fail fast, and learn from each experience
* **Stay ahead of advances in AI/ML (including LLMs, NLP, recommendation systems, and predictive analytics) and apply them thoughtfully to our products**

**Good Feedback — Consider the perspective of others**

* Listen actively and respond effectively through a variety of channels
* Give and receive candid and constructive feedback
* Promote trust and encourage teamwork to allow the product team to do their best work

* **3 to 10 years in a software engineering role**
* **BE/BTech degree from a top institution**
* You want to work in a highly collaborative environment: we believe a team can be stronger than its individual parts

It is rare to have a company that both deeply impacts its customers and is able to provide its services across a massive population. We are also the fastest growing healthcare company in the country and are driving that impact across millions of new patients every year. ,

description:
**Job Title**
Senior AI Engineer (Hybrid)
  
  
**Job Description**
The Senior AI Engineer leads the design, build and operation of the machine learning models, large language model (LLM) services and agentic systems that drive Kaplan’s AI strategy. Your remit spans learner-facing products and internal AI-first business processes. You will be a technical reference point for the AI Engineering team, owning the design of the systems you build and helping set the standard for how we deliver reliable, secure and scalable AI services.
  
  
**As The Senior AI Engineer, You Will**

* Lead the design, development and delivery of machine learning, LLM and agentic solutions for learner products and internal business workflows.
* Architect agentic workflows, including tool use, structured outputs, multi-agent orchestration and human-in-the-loop patterns.
* Champion engineering standards and best practice, and review the designs and code of other engineers.
* Own the reliability, cost, security and performance of AI services in production.
* Build and maintain evaluation tooling and observability for models and LLM-based systems.
* Mentor AI Engineers and help grow our engineering capability.
* Collaborate with teams across Kaplan, including product, data science, design and learning teams, to translate requirements into technical direction.
* Stay current with new AI tools and techniques and set direction on their practical adoption.

**Detailed Responsibilities**
Technical leadership and mentoring
  
  

* Set and champion standards for engineering quality, code review and reusable patterns.
* Lead the technical approach on ambiguous or novel problems.
* Own the design of the systems you build and shape architectural decisions across the AI platform, aligned with enterprise architecture.
* Mentor and develop AI Engineers through review, pairing and technical guidance.

Model and agent development
  
  

* Lead algorithm and framework selection, and design retrieval and grounding strategies, prompts and embeddings.
* Design, build and evaluate agentic workfl ows using frameworks such as Microsoft Agent Framework.
* Evaluate models and LLM-based systems using agreed metrics and methods, including golden datasets, LLM-as-judge evaluation, and tracing and observability tooling.
* Partner with data science colleagues, who own modelling and evaluation

Innovation and growth
  
  

* Assess emerging techniques and paradigms and set direction on their practical adoption.
* Champion new ideas by building prototypes and translating research into tangible solutions.
* Share fi ndings with product and learning stakeholders with clear impact statements.

You’ll also carry out other duties, within the broad scope and spirit of your role, as requested by your manager. Our business continuously evolves, so your role will too.
  
  
**What you might be doing now; Your current role, or recent roles, may be:**

* AI Engineer at Kaplan, ready to step up
* Senior Machine Learning Engineer
* Senior Software Engineer leading AI features
* Machine Learning Engineer leading the delivery of LLM or agentic systems

**What You’ll Bring To The Role**
This role suits an experienced, pragmatic engineer who leads by example: someone who balances rapid experimentation with production-level rigour and raises the standard of those around them.
  
  
**You Will Have**

* 5+ years’ experience in software or machine learning engineering.
* Substantial experience (typically 2+ years) building and operating LLM-based or agentic systems in production.
* Strong Python skills and knowledge of ML libraries (PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn).
* Experience with agent and LLM frameworks (e.g. Microsoft Agent Framework, LangGraph) and prompt engineering.
* Strong MLOps experience: CI/CD, container orchestration and infrastructure-as-code, with cloud platforms (Azure preferred).
* Knowledge of NoSQL/document databases (e.g. Azure Cosmos DB) and vector search (e.g. Azure AI Search), plus a solid grounding in relational/SQL database design and querying.
* Experience leading technical decisions, mentoring engineers and reviewing designs and code.
* A strong understanding of data privacy, security and responsible AI, and the ability to explain complex ideas to non-specialists.

**Desirable**

* Experience with Google’s agent platform (Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform/Vertex AI, including the Agent Development Kit).
* Familiarity with agent interoperability standards such as the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent2Agent (A2A).
* Additional programming languages such as C# and the .NET framework.
* Experience with education-specific standards such as xAPI, LTI or LMS plug-ins.

**How You Can Build Your Career At Kaplan**
From this role, your potential paths for career progression at Kaplan include:
  
  

* Principal AI Engineer, deepening technical expertise as a senior individual contributor
* AI Platform Lead, owning our AI platform and engineering standards
* Head of AI Engineering, leading the engineering function

Role Description

The
**Technical Lead, Microsoft Ecosystem**
is a full-time remote role responsible for the architecture, delivery, and long-term health of enterprise solutions built on the Microsoft cloud — Power Platform, Dataverse, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Fabric, Azure, and Microsoft 365.

This is a hands-on leadership role on a multi-year engagement with a major US affordable-housing owner-operator managing more than 23,000 units. You will own the technical foundation across a portfolio of connected builds: a Dataverse-backed collections and legal case management system, a SharePoint-based company intranet, AI agents serving both, and a reporting layer drawing live property data from Yardi via Microsoft Fabric.

The work is explicitly about
**durability, not demos**
. Solutions must run reliably for years, handle enterprise data volumes without failure, and survive staff turnover on both sides. You will set the standards that make that true — solution architecture, ALM, error handling, governance — and hold the team to them.

Key Responsibilities

**Architecture and design**

* Own the Dataverse data model: tables, relationships, alternate keys, choice strategy, and the denormalisation decisions that keep model-driven apps performant at scale
* Design solution architecture across multiple environments and workstreams, including publisher strategy, solution layering, and dependency management
* Translate business requirements into technical designs, and defend those designs to both client stakeholders and the delivery team

**Build and integration**

* Lead the design of complex Power Automate flows — child flow libraries, try/catch/finally patterns, trigger filtering, concurrency control — built to stay inside service protection limits
* Architect and implement data integration from external warehouses into Dataverse using Dataflows, Power Query, and Fabric pipelines, including incremental refresh and change detection
* Work with
  **Microsoft Fabric**
  — Lakehouse and Warehouse SQL analytics endpoints, Dataflow Gen2, OneLake — to bring third-party and legacy system data into the platform
* Resolve cross-tenant authentication, service principal provisioning, and connection reference strategy across environments

**Agents and AI**

* Design, build and deploy
  **Copilot Studio agents**
  grounded in Dataverse, SharePoint and document libraries — including topics, actions, knowledge sources and fallback behaviour
* Connect agents to Power Automate flows and custom connectors so they can take action, not just answer questions
* Deploy across the right channels — Teams, SharePoint, the intranet, and embedded inside model-driven apps
* Own agent governance: what the agent can see, what it can do, how responses are grounded, and how hallucination risk is contained on real client data
* Instrument and review agent performance — what people ask, where it fails, what to improve
* Apply
  **AI Builder**
  where it earns its place: document and form processing, prediction models, category classification against operational data

**Delivery and governance**

* Own ALM end to end — managed and unmanaged solutions, the pac CLI, deployment settings files, environment variables, connection references
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps using the Power Platform Build Tools
* Define and enforce governance: DLP policies, managed environments, security roles, and the Power Platform admin standards the client will inherit
* Produce architecture documentation and run knowledge transfer so the client is never dependent on a single individual

**Leadership**

* Mentor developers, review work, and raise the technical standard of the team
* Coordinate across client IT, HR, and business stakeholders in a US time zone
* Make and communicate the hard calls — including telling a client when an approach will not hold up

Qualifications

**Required**

* 7+ years in the Microsoft ecosystem, with demonstrable depth in
  **Power Platform and Dataverse**
* Proven experience designing Dataverse data models for production systems at scale — not prototypes
* Advanced
  **Power Automate**
  : child flows, error handling patterns, performance tuning, and working within service protection limits
* Strong
  **Power Apps**
  across both model-driven and canvas, including an understanding of delegation limits and where they break
* **Copilot Studio**
  — hands-on experience building and deploying production agents, including Dataverse and SharePoint grounding, actions via Power Automate, channel deployment, and authentication
* **AI Builder**
  — document processing, form processing, prediction models
* Hands-on
  **Dataflows and Power Query**
  , including query folding and incremental refresh
* Working knowledge of
  **Microsoft Fabric**
  — Lakehouse or Warehouse, SQL analytics endpoints, Dataflow Gen2
* **Power Platform ALM**
  in practice: solution strategy, pac CLI, deployment settings, environment promotion
* **Azure DevOps**
  CI/CD with the Power Platform Build Tools
* **Microsoft Entra ID**
  : authentication, service principals, app registrations, cross-tenant access
* **SharePoint Online**
  : site architecture, permissions, document libraries, and intranet delivery
* **Power BI**
  : data modelling, DAX, and the judgement to know what belongs in a report rather than an app
* Strong T-SQL and relational database fundamentals
* Clear written and spoken English, with the ability to run a client call unsupported

**Strongly preferred**

* Experience with
  **Yardi Voyager**
  or comparable property management systems
* Background in
  **US real estate**
  , affordable housing, or property management
* HRIS integration experience — Dayforce, Ceridian, or similar APIs
* Microsoft 365 Copilot and declarative agent development
* Power Platform Center of Excellence toolkit and governance frameworks
* Familiarity with ITIL or a comparable service management framework

**Education and certification**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* Microsoft certifications highly valued:
  **PL-600 Power Platform Solution Architect**
  , PL-400, PL-200, DP-600 Fabric Analytics Engineer, AZ-104, MS-102, and any current Copilot Studio or agent credential

What we're actually looking for

Someone who has maintained what they built. The ability to design a system is table stakes; we need someone who has lived with one in production, watched it fail in unexpected ways, and changed how they build as a result.

Agent work is a real part of this role, not a side experiment. We need someone who has shipped an agent that people actually use, and who understands the difference between a demo that answers questions and a production agent that has to be right.

You should be comfortable saying "that approach won't scale" to a client, and able to explain why in terms a non-technical stakeholder understands.

**Overview**
As part of our ongoing digital and AI transformation, we are expanding our security capabilities to securely enable
**AI-driven platforms, data products, and cloud-native services**
. The
**Security Engineer AI Cloud**
will play a critical role in protecting AI systems, cloud infrastructure, and data pipelines while enabling responsible and scalable adoption of artificial intelligence across the enterprise.
  
  
This role combines
**hands-on security engineering**
with
**architectural thinking**
, focusing on
**secure AI platforms, workloads, and integrations in cloud environments**
. The position works closely with Cloud, DevOps, Architecture, AI Data and analytics , and Engineering teams to ensure security is embedded across the
**AI/ML lifecycle**
.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
Reporting to the Director of Security Engineering, the AI Security Engineer is responsible for
**designing, implementing, and monitoring security controls**
for AI-enabled systems and cloud infrastructure. This role ensures AI solutions are secure by design, compliant with governance standards, and resilient against emerging threats such as data leakage, prompt manipulation, model abuse, and cloud misconfiguration.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**AI & Application Security**

* Implement security controls for AI/ML platforms, including model training, fine-tuning, deployment, and inference environments
* Support secure design of AI-enabled applications, including copilots, chatbots, APIs, and agent-based workflows
* Conduct risk assessments and threat modeling for AI solutions (e.g., data leakage, misuse, prompt injection, model exposure)
* Lead the implementation of AI guardrails, monitoring, and secure access controls

**Cloud & Platform Security**

* Design, implement, and maintain security controls for cloud-based AI workloads across Azure, AWS, and/or GCP
* Maintain and operate Cloud Native Application Protection Platform (CNAPP) capabilities (CSPM, CWPP, workload security)
* Participate in the design and review of new cloud and AI projects to ensure security requirements are built in from inception
* Secure containerized, serverless, and data platforms supporting AI solutions

**DevSecOps & Engineering Enablement**

* Implement and review security controls in CI/CD pipelines, including those supporting AI and data workloads
* Partner with DevOps and Engineering teams to embed security-as-code and infrastructure-as-code controls
* Support automation of security testing, monitoring, and policy enforcement across cloud and AI environments

**Threat, Risk & Operations**

* Conduct cloud and AI security assessments and audits aligned with NIST, CIS, and industry best practices
* Monitor cloud and AI platforms for security events, vulnerabilities, and anomalous behavior
* Participate in incident response for cloud and AI-related security issues
* Stay current on emerging AI security threats, cloud attack techniques, and defensive technologies

**Standards, Governance & Advisory**

title: Staff HR Technology Solutions Architect
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Staff HR Technology Architect is the senior technical authority for OpenGov’s HR technology ecosystem, responsible for the architecture, integration design, and long-term technical direction of the systems that manage employee data across the entire employee lifecycle. Based in Pune and reporting to the Director of Enterprise Applications and Engineering, this individual-contributor role sets the technical vision for the Workday platform and the broader HR application portfolio, ensuring the ecosystem is scalable, secure, compliant, and aligned to the needs of a global workforce across the US and India.
  
  
We are looking for a seasoned architect with deep domain and technical expertise across the Workday platform and the adjacent, integrated systems that make up the HR technology ecosystem — spanning payroll, benefits, talent management, talent acquisition, onboarding and offboarding, employee engagement, compliance, and HR operations. This is a hands-on, staff-level individual contributor with a dotted-line leadership mandate: no direct reports, but expected to guide and mentor HR application administrators, lead virtual teams on major initiatives, and influence the direction both technical and business teams take with HR technology. While the role is primarily architecture and design, it also carries hands-on technical delivery — the architect personally builds and delivers the most complex or high-risk integrations, configurations, and reports. The architect owns integration architecture and the HR data model end to end across best-of-breed systems, partners with the Manager, HR Technology on delivery, and serves as the design authority on data governance, security, and emerging AI and automation across the stack.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Technical Architecture & Systems Design**

* Own the end-to-end architecture of the HR technology ecosystem — Workday (Core HCM, Payroll, Benefits, Absence, Time Tracking, Compensation, Recruiting, Talent, Reporting, and Security) and the surrounding application portfolio — establishing design standards, patterns, and technical roadmaps.
* Own the architecture across a best-of-breed, multi-platform landscape — the core HRIS (Workday) plus payroll (e.g., ADP), applicant tracking (Ashby), employee engagement (CultureAmp), ERP (e.g., NetSuite), SSO/identity, compliance/training platforms, data-warehousing and BI tooling (e.g., Snowflake), and iPaaS/integration platforms (e.g., Workato) — ensuring the systems interoperate as a coherent whole.
* Define target-state architecture and multi-year technical roadmaps that scale with a growing, globally distributed workforce, balancing configuration, extensibility, and total cost of ownership.
* Evaluate new Workday releases, features, and third-party solutions; make build-vs-configure-vs-buy recommendations and lead architecture and design reviews.
* Provide deep, hands-on technical expertise across the ecosystem — anchored in the Workday stack (advanced configuration, the business process framework, calculated fields, security design, and complex reporting) and extending to adjacent platforms such as ADP, Ashby, CultureAmp, and NetSuite/ERP.

**Integration Architecture & Data Flows**

* Design and govern the integration architecture across the HR ecosystem (e.g., ADP, Ashby, engagement survey, SSO/identity, ERP, and downstream data-warehouse/BI platforms such as Snowflake), leveraging iPaaS/integration platforms (e.g., Workato) where appropriate and establishing patterns, standards, and error handling and monitoring.
* Own the HR data model and the flow of employee data from hire to retire, ensuring integrity, lineage, and consistency across integrated systems.
* Serve as design authority for Workday integrations (EIB, Core Connectors, Studio, and web service APIs), iPaaS platforms (e.g., Workato), and downstream data platform feeds.
* Maintain a working understanding of how HRIS data ties into ERP (e.g., NetSuite) and other enterprise systems, and lead the design of those interfaces.

**Technical Strategy & Influence**

* Set the technical direction for HR technology and influence the decisions both technical and business teams make when adopting or changing technology.
* Partner with HR Operations, Payroll, Benefits, Talent Acquisition, Talent Management, HR Business Partners, IT, and Workplace leaders to translate business strategy into a coherent systems strategy.
* Act as a trusted technical advisor to leadership, framing trade-offs, risks, and options for major HR technology investments and platform decisions.
* Provide dotted-line technical leadership and mentorship to HR application administrators; lead virtual and matrixed teams on large initiatives and build technical depth and backup coverage across critical domains.

**Data Governance, Security & AI**

* Serve as the design authority for HR data governance, privacy, and security — defining data structures, access models, and controls across the US and India.
* Establish standards for HR data quality, master data, and reporting and analytics that feed data-warehouse and BI platforms (e.g., Snowflake).
* Identify and pilot opportunities to apply automation and AI within the HR technology stack, establishing responsible-use and data-handling guardrails.
* Ensure the architecture supports compliance requirements across geographies (audits, policy acknowledgements, and mandatory training) and evolving data-privacy regulations.

**Delivery, Vendors & Best Practices**

* Lead complex, cross-functional HR technology projects end to end from an architecture and design standpoint — shaping solutions, reviewing designs, and guiding delivery teams.
* Stay hands-on with technical delivery — personally building and delivering the most complex or high-risk configurations, integrations, and reports rather than limiting the role to design and oversight.
* Partner with the Manager, HR Technology and the administration team to translate architecture into configuration, and maintain documentation of architecture, standards, and system specifications.
* Manage strategic third-party vendor and implementation-partner relationships from a technical and architecture perspective.
* Stay current on Workday releases, HR technology trends, and best practices; exhibit sound judgment, discretion, and confidentiality in handling sensitive employee data.

**Requirements And Preferred Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required.
* 10+ years of progressive HR technology / HRIS functional and technical experience, including significant time in an architecture, principal, or senior technical individual-contributor capacity.
* Demonstrated experience as a technical authority who sets direction and influences both technical and business stakeholders — this is a senior individual-contributor role, not an entry-level or first architecture role.
* Deep, hands-on expertise in a core HRIS — Workday strongly preferred — across the full module stack (Absence, Benefits, Compensation, Core HCM, Payroll, Recruiting, Reporting, Security, Talent, Time Tracking), including advanced configuration and the business process framework.
* Hands-on experience across a multi-platform HR technology ecosystem — not limited to a single HRIS — including payroll (e.g., ADP), applicant tracking (Ashby preferred), employee engagement (CultureAmp preferred), SSO/identity, and compliance/training platforms.
* Strong Workday integration expertise (EIB, Core Connectors, Studio, and web services/APIs) and proven experience designing enterprise integration architectures, including iPaaS/integration platforms (e.g., Workato).
* Expertise in HR data modeling, data governance, and how HRIS data flows into downstream data-warehouse and BI systems (e.g., Snowflake).
* Experience with data-warehousing tools (e.g., Snowflake) and iPaaS/integration platforms (e.g., Workato).
* Willingness and ability to perform hands-on technical delivery — configuration, integration development, and reporting — in addition to architecture, design, and oversight; this is not a design-only role.
* Broad domain expertise across payroll, benefits, talent management, talent acquisition, onboarding/offboarding, employee engagement, and general HR operations.
* Experience supporting HR systems across multiple geographies, ideally including both the US and India.
* Proficiency with Workday report writing and complex calculated fields.
* Experience with an applicant tracking system (Ashby preferred) and an employee engagement survey platform (CultureAmp preferred).
* Demonstrated ability to mentor administrators and provide dotted-line technical leadership without formal reporting authority.
* Strong understanding of HR compliance, data privacy, and security considerations across regions.
* Exposure to automation and AI applications within HR technology a plus.
* Familiarity with NetSuite or a comparable ERP, and how HRIS data integrates with it, a plus (nice to have).
* Excellent communication skills, able to influence and align technical and business stakeholders at all levels of a globally distributed organization.
* Workday certifications (e.g., Integrations, HCM, or Pro) preferred.
* Experience using Google Workspace a plus.
* Exhibits sound judgment, discretion, and confidentiality.

**Why OpenGov?**
**A Mission That Matters.**
At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.
  
  
**Opportunity to Innovate**
The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.
  
  
**A Team of Passionate, Driven People**
This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.
  
  
**A Place to Make Your Mark**
We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.
  
  
**Benefits That Work For You**
Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:

title: AI Product Builder
description:
**AI Product Builder | Consumer Experiences**

TL;DR: ₹1 lakh/month. HSR Layout, Bengaluru. Full-time, in-person preferred, with flexibility for an exceptional fit. Use AI to build and refine consumer experiences. No CV or prior experience required. Apply by email, then an unpaid 48-hour workout assignment.

I'm Vishnu, building Aira. AI is the biggest equaliser we have, but nobody has figured out the consumer use case yet. I think Aira will be the reason everyday people start using AI daily.

I don't believe chatting is the final interface for AI. So Aira is built around a hand-drawn character that feels alive, shapes what's on your screen, and brings voice, animation and music together. The goal is the best answer, delivered in the best way for your situation, with help acting on it.

Say you're deciding what to cook. Aira helps you pick a meal, shows the ingredients, arranges the purchase with your confirmation. While you cook, it keeps the recipe and your current step on screen, speaks short instructions, and waits while your hands are busy. The same screen won't work at the gym, in meditation or while fixing a tyre. The conversation, the actions and what you see and hear should feel like one experience that adapts to what you're doing.

I'm hiring people who would have wanted to work on the first iPhone. People who obsessed over the small details that made something unfamiliar feel natural, and cared about what a person felt the first time they used it.

We've built the foundation. Your job is to take an experience, decide how it should work, build it with AI, and keep agonising until it feels right. In practice: tuning prompts and behaviour files, building or changing screen components with AI, and testing what you've made.

You may not yet be able to explain why an interaction feels incomplete. I want you to follow that feeling and build a better version. That's why we don't ask for a CV, prior experience or a coding background. We need product thinking, creativity and ownership — you question what AI gives you, make it work, and keep improving it.

We're launching in San Francisco this month. You'll work directly with me and help shape what people experience the first time they meet Aira.

**The process**

You'll build a workout experience from a minimal starter. We give you a stepper, a timer and the component plumbing; you decide how it behaves and build the rest. Anyone can attempt it, before any screening. You have 48 hours after receiving it. It's unpaid, for evaluation only, and your work stays yours.

AI helps me review, but I pick the shortlist myself. Shortlisted candidates get a 30-minute conversation. I aim to reply within 24 hours of submission and finish within a week.

**To apply**

* Email vrvv@airaai.in with the subject "AI Product Builder | Your name". Attach anything you've made that you'd like me to see. We'll reply with the assignment.

description:

**What We Need To See**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, data science, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent experience and 8+ years of experience in technical Developer Relations, ML engineering, AI platforms, model infrastructure, cloud platforms, solution architecture, or startup technical engagement.

* Hands-on experience with inference optimization and model efficiency techniques such as quantization, distillation, pruning, speculative decoding, batching, KV cache optimization, RLHF, RLAIF, DPO, or other post-training and alignment methods.

description:

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

**Tide Facts**

* Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
* Over 2 million members across UK and India
* Over $300 million raised in funding
* Over 2,800 Tideans globally
* Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
* We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

**About The Role**

Tide is hiring a Director of Engineering to lead the engineering organisation behind KYX (KYC and KYB). Our vision for KYX is a world where every genuine business, business owner, their team, and everyone connected to them, onboards to Tide in minutes, unlocks the products they need as they grow, and never has to think twice about their data, while we identify bad actors, stop them at the door, continuously review their activity and off-board them the moment they're found.

You will be accountable for engineering strategy, organisation and execution across three domains. Onboarding KYX covers identity and access for registration and login, due diligence policy execution and vendor orchestration across the onboarding journey, and the risk scoring and agentic AI that assesses new applicants. Continuous KYX covers ongoing due diligence through periodic and event-triggered reviews, and how business owners bring their own team members onto their account. Risk Scoring is the KYX Scoring & ML team whose models power decisions across both domains.

This role sits at the intersection of regulated risk operations, member-facing conversion and applied AI. KYX Ops and KYX Policy set the rules you build for, Second Line of Defence sets the risk appetite, and our regulators set the bar. We need someone who can raise onboarding conversion and due diligence quality while driving the cost of KYX servicing per member down, and who can scale agentic solutions into workflows where a wrong answer has consequences for a member and for Tide.

As Director of Engineering, KYX you will

* Own the engineering strategy and organisation for KYX, from onboarding identity, access and due diligence through continuous monitoring to risk scoring, unifying leadership that today sits in separate Onboarding and Continuous KYX lines.
* Lead engineering across backend, frontend, data science and ML engineering, distributed across Hyderabad, Delhi, Sofia, Belgrade, Bucharest and Vilnius.
* Own KYX Scoring & ML as a shared capability serving both onboarding and ongoing decisioning, including the model lifecycle end to end from development through backtesting and staged rollout to production monitoring.
* Scale agentic AI in regulated workflows, from onboarding risk scoring through to screening, review and verification, in line with Tide's agentic governance framework.
* Work with KYX Ops, KYX Policy, Second Line of Defence and Product across the UK, EU and India, and with IAM on the still-to-be-sharpened boundary around login and access.
* Deliver measurable outcomes: higher automated decisioning rates, better due diligence and screening quality, and a falling KYX cost per member.
* Build once, deploy globally, and keep market-specific logic isolated.

This is one of the most important engineering roles at Tide. You will shape how quickly and how well we onboard members, how confidently we scale into new markets under our own licences, and how far applied AI can compound into a lasting advantage in a regulated environment.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Experience leading engineering organisations in identity, onboarding, fraud, financial crime or another regulated decisioning domain.
* Strong track record of turning platform investment into measurable outcomes: conversion, due diligence quality, unit economics and workflow automation.
* Experience taking machine learning from development into production at scale, and owning model performance once live.
* Experience operating in a regulated environment, working with Ops, Policy and second line risk and compliance functions,
* Strong judgement across organisation design, delivery, platform strategy, data architecture and technical quality.
* Ability to lead distributed teams across multiple markets and unify previously separate engineering lines behind one roadmap.
* Experience deploying AI or agentic systems inside regulated workflows, with a clear view on governance, evaluation and human oversight, would be a bonus.

**What You’ll Get In Return**

Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans:

* Competitive Compensation - Competitive salary and share options.
* Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.
* Parental Leave – Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.
* Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.
* Health Insurance – Private family insurance with additional OPD coverage and top-up options.
* Life & Accident Cover – Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection.
* Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.
* Volunteering & Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.
* Learning & Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.
* WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.
* Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office.
* Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it’s time for a replacement.
* Snacks & Meals – Office perks with snacks, coffee, tea, and lunch (location dependent).

TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING

At Tide, we champion a
**flexible workplace**
model that supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams.

While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives.

We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.

Position Summary
  
  
This is OUR story... and YOUR next chapter
  
  
At HCA Healthcare, we are using AI and machine learning to improve how healthcare is delivered, operated, and continuously improved at enterprise scale. Our teams are helping improve clinical outcomes, reduce manual workload, and expand the reach of our care teams. If you're passionate about using technology to improve human life, this is where your work truly matters.
  
  
What you will accomplish in this role
  
  
We are seeking a Senior AI Engineer who is passionate about building production-ready AI applications using Generative AI, Agentic AI, and modern software engineering practices. This role is focused on designing, developing, and deploying AI solutions that solve meaningful business and clinical problems.
  
  
The ideal candidate has hands-on experience building and delivering production AI solutions for enterprise users and enjoys translating business requirements into scalable, reliable AI applications. They bring strong software engineering fundamentals, applied AI expertise, and a collaborative mindset to deliver solutions from concept through production.
  
  
**Major Responsibilities**

* Design, build, and maintain production-grade Generative AI, Agentic AI, and machine learning applications.
* Develop evaluation and testing approaches to measure model performance, identify regressions, and improve solution quality.
* Apply LLMs, multimodal models, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), structured extraction, and tool calling to solve real-world healthcare workflows.
* Partner with Engineering, Product, Data, and Operations teams to integrate AI capabilities into HCA's systems.
* Improve the reliability, observability, guardrails, and monitoring of production AI applications.
* Stay current with advancements in AI technologies and apply them pragmatically to deliver business value.

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree Required
* Master's degree Preferred
* 3-5 years of software engineering, applied AI, machine learning, or related technical experience, including at least 1 year of recent experience designing and delivering production-grade Generative AI solutions. Required
* Or equivalent combination of education and/or experience

**Licenses, Certifications, & Training**

* No licenses, certifications, or training specified in the source job description. Not Specified

**Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, Behaviors**

* Hands-on experience with modern AI systems, including LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agents, structured extraction, classification, or workflow automation. Required
* Proficiency in Python, with experience building cloud-native applications on AWS or GCP and working with relational and/or NoSQL databases. Required
* Practical experience with prompt engineering, tool calling, retrieval, model selection, context management, and AI application debugging. Required
* Experience evaluating AI system quality using metrics, test datasets, human review, and error analysis. Required
* Strong software engineering fundamentals, including system design, testing, scalability, and maintainability. Required
* Hands-on experience building retrieval-augmented AI applications using vector databases, embeddings, and semantic search. Required
* Experience working in healthcare, insurance, financial services, or another regulated industry. Preferred
* Familiarity with AI evaluation, prompt optimization, guardrails, or human-in-the-loop workflows. Preferred

title: Consultant - Data Architect
description:
General Position Information
  
  
Reports directly to (Title): Manager
  
  
Matrix reports to (Title): As applicable based on functional alignment
  
  
Direct Reports: No
  
  
Job Code: 1875
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
The Staff Data Architect is a hands-on technical role responsible for designing and personally building the data architecture patterns that power HCA’s GCP-based Lakehouse and multi-modal ingestion platforms. Unlike a purely advisory architecture role, this position is expected to spend a substantial portion of its time in code — authoring reference implementations, prototyping ingestion frameworks, writing production-grade pipelines, and proving out patterns before they are adopted at scale.
  
  
This role owns architecture for a defined platform or data domain rather than the enterprise as a whole, and operates as the senior technical authority within that scope. The Staff Data Architect translates business and clinical requirements into durable designs, then demonstrates those designs in working code that engineering teams extend. Design decisions are earned through implementation: if a pattern cannot be built, benchmarked, and operated by the architect who proposed it, it is not ready to become a standard.
  
  
The role bridges the Principal Data Architect’s enterprise direction and the Staff Data Engineer’s delivery execution. It requires deep GCP expertise, strong software engineering discipline (test-driven development, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code), and the ability to influence without direct authority. The culture of the organization places an emphasis on teamwork, so social and interpersonal skills are equally important as technical capability. Due to the emerging and fast-evolving nature of GCP and AI technologies, the position requires staying well-informed of technological advancements and being proficient at putting new innovations into effective practice.
  
  
At HCA DT&I, your deliverables will influence patient care. Every process, technology, and decision matters.
  
  
Major Responsibilities
  
  
Core Competencies
  
  
The following are highlighted entrepreneurial competencies and core expectations for the job/role:
  
  

* Architectural judgment grounded in hands-on implementation
* Deep technical expertise in cloud data platforms
* Strong problem-solving, systems design, and software engineering skills
* Ability to bridge business, clinical, and technical domains
* Communication and interpersonal skills; influence without authority
* Understand strategic imperatives

Hands-On Architecture & Reference Implementation
  
  

* Design data architecture patterns for a defined platform or domain within the GCP Lakehouse ecosystem, and personally build the reference implementations that prove them.
* Write production-quality code (Python, SQL, Java/Scala) for ingestion frameworks, transformation pipelines, and platform tooling — not prototypes thrown over the wall, but modular, tested, reusable code that serves as the pattern others follow.
* Benchmark and validate architectural options empirically: build competing approaches, measure cost, throughput, and latency, and let evidence drive the standard.
* Spend meaningful time in the codebase alongside engineers — pairing, reviewing pull requests, and debugging production issues — to keep designs anchored in operational reality.
* Produce architecture decision records (ADRs), reference architectures, and diagrams that are backed by working artifacts in source control.
* Modernize and refactor legacy pipelines, leading migrations through direct contribution rather than delegation alone.

Lakehouse & Data Platform Design
  
  

* Design and build Lakehouse environments using BigQuery, Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, and GCS, including schema evolution, ACID compliance, partitioning, clustering, metadata management, and lifecycle policies.
* Model data and access patterns that serve both analytical and AI-driven workloads; implement the initial models and validate them against real query workloads.
* Optimize storage and compute for cost and performance across large-scale document and data repositories; instrument pipelines so cost and performance are observable, not estimated.
* Define and uphold SLAs for timely delivery of data, and build the monitoring that proves they are met.

Ingestion, Processing & AI Enablement
  
  

* Design, build, and tune ETL/ELT and real-time ingestion pipelines using Dataflow, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Kafka, Spark Streaming, Cloud Run, Cloud Composer, GKE, and Cloud Functions.
* Build multi-modal ingestion capabilities handling structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data (documents, text, images, PDFs, audio/video metadata).
* Implement AI-assisted ingestion patterns — semantic chunking, embedding generation, metadata extraction, classification, and enrichment — in partnership with the AI/ML practice, and integrate them into pipelines hands-on.
* Partner with AI/ML teams on vector storage and retrieval (RAG) patterns aligned with enterprise governance standards.
* Ensure ingestion frameworks are resilient, observable, idempotent, and designed for continuous evolution.

API Design & Contracts
  
  

* Design and implement REST and event-driven APIs aligned with OpenAPI specifications, versioning standards, and backward compatibility principles.
* Apply enterprise API governance — naming conventions, authentication patterns, rate limiting, pagination, and error handling — and contribute the shared libraries and templates that make compliance the default.
* Build API layers serving both human-facing applications and AI agent consumers, ensuring consistent contract design across downstream integrations.
* Implement secure API access patterns for PHI-sensitive and regulated data, incorporating encryption, scoping, and audit logging.
* Review and validate API designs from vendor and internal delivery teams prior to implementation.

Engineering Practice & Quality
  
  

* Champion test-driven development, continuous integration, and automated deployment by building them into the platforms this role delivers.
* Implement unit and integration tests; conduct performance testing where appropriate.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code (GitHub, Terraform) for data platforms.
* Implement automated workflows that lower manual/operational costs and move the company closer to democratizing data.
* Enable self-service data architecture supporting query exploration, dashboards, data catalog, and rich data discovery.

Governance, Security & Compliance
  
  

* Apply and enforce best practices for data governance, security, privacy, and compliance (HIPAA, GDPR) across structured and unstructured data.
* Ensure designs align with enterprise policies for data retention, lineage, access control, and auditability — and implement the controls, not just the policy.
* Participate in and lead architectural design reviews to ensure adherence to standards and patterns.

Collaboration, Mentorship & Influence
  
  

* Collaborate with business, clinical, analytics, and engineering stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable solutions.
* Partner with the Principal Data Architect to align domain architecture with enterprise direction, and provide implementation feedback that shapes enterprise standards.
* Mentor Staff and Senior Data Engineers through code review, pairing, and design coaching; raise the technical ceiling of the team by example rather than by directive.
* Lead data analysis efforts and solution proposals to data-related and data architecture problems.
* Be a leader in the HCA data community. Evangelize architecture and engineering best practices, participate or present at community events, and encourage the continual growth and development of others.
* Be curious. Be growth minded. Encourage and enable this in others.
* Demonstrate professional and personal maturity through self-leadership.
* Build productive and healthy relationships within the department and other teams to foster growth of our culture, our people, and our platforms.
* Practices and adheres to the “Code of Conduct” philosophy and “Mission and Value Statement.”
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, related technical field, or equivalent experience Required
* Master's degree in computer science or related field Preferred
* 7+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Architecture, or equivalent hands-on data platform development Required
* 2+ years of experience in a Cloud Data or Information Architect capacity Required
* 3+ years of experience in Healthcare Preferred
* 8+ years of experience in Information Technology Required

**Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, Behaviors**
A successful candidate will demonstrate:
  
  

* Hands-on experience designing and building enterprise data solutions on Google Cloud Platform or another major cloud provider — with a portfolio of systems personally built, not only specified.
* Must-have skills/tools:
* Python and SQL at production depth; JVM-based languages (Java/Scala)
* BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Dataflow, Dataproc, Cloud Composer
* Pub/Sub, Kafka, Spark Streaming
* Cloud Run, GKE, Cloud Functions
* Lakehouse formats: Iceberg, Delta Lake, Parquet, Avro, JSON
* CI/CD pipelines, Git/GitHub, test-driven development
* Nice-to-have skills/tools:
* Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, Dynatrace
* Bigtable, Cloud SQL, Cloud Spanner
* Microservices architecture, OpenAPI/REST and event-driven API design
* Vertex AI, LangChain, embeddings, RAG patterns
* Healthcare domain knowledge/experience
* Experience with document and unstructured data processing, including ingestion, enrichment, and indexing.
* Practical experience integrating LLMs and AI frameworks into production data pipelines.
* Strong understanding of data security, privacy, and regulatory requirements (HIPAA, GDPR) in cloud environments.
* Strong ability to assemble large, complex data sets meeting functional and non-functional requirements.
* Strong ability to identify, design, and implement internal process improvements, including redesigning data platforms for greater scalability and optimized data delivery.
* Expert ability using source control management and CI/CD automation tools.
* Strong understanding of Agile methodologies and how to apply Agile within the team.
* Ability to communicate complex architectures clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, and to present and facilitate technical ideas.
* Proven ability to complete work, make sound decisions, and plan and accomplish goals without explicit direction/guidance from leadership.
* Demonstrates an empathetic and growth mindset with a willingness to learn new skills, technologies, and methodologies.
* Coaches and mentors engineers within and external to the team.
* Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.

**Certifications (a Plus, But Not Required)**

* GCP Professional Data Engineer
* GCP Professional Cloud Architect

We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve.

* Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive

* Pension / Retirement benefits
* Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.

**The Impact You Will Have In This Role**
The Development family is responsible for creating, designing, deploying, and supporting applications, programs, and software solutions. May include research, new development, prototyping, modification, reuse, re-engineering, maintenance, or any other activities related to software products used internally or externally on product platforms supported by the firm. The software development process requires in-depth subject matter expertise in existing and emerging development methodologies, tools, and programming languages. Software Developers work closely with business partners and / or external clients in defining requirements and implementing solutions. The Software Development Engineer In Test (SDET) role encompasses automation development and execution, functional, and non-functional testing. The SDET role specializes in the design, development, execution, and maintenance of automated tests to ensure the quality of software products. Partners with team members to understand software requirements and execute automated tests that validate the functionality while considering privacy and security requirements
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities**

* Contribute expertise in the application of different software development and testing methodologies, tools, and technologies
* Design, develop, execute, and maintain automated tests across the delivery lifecycle
* Contribute to the design of the automation framework and enhancement
* Maintain traceability from user stories through test cases to automated scripts
* Identify dependencies, define, and communicate environmental and data requirements
* Act as a technical expert on one or more applications utilized by DTCC
* Research and evaluate technical solutions consistent with DTCC technology standards
* Align risk and control processes into day-to-day responsibilities to monitor and mitigate risk; escalates appropriately
* Partner with team members to understand software requirements and design automated tests that validate the functionality while considering privacy and security requirements
* Create applications and construct unit test cases that ensure compliance with functional requirements
* Work with peers to mature ways of working to implement and maintain continuous testing within the software delivery processes and integrate automated test with CI/CD pipeline
* Collaborate with internal and external teams on development, testing, troubleshooting, and improve overall software quality
* Aligns risk and control processes into day to day responsibilities to monitor and mitigate risk; escalates appropriately

**Qualifications**

* Minimum of 6 years of related experience
* Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent experience

**Talents Needed For Success**

* Hands On experience with test automation frameworks and tools, such as Selenium, JUnit, TestNG, etc. as well as CI/CD technologies (e.g. Cloudbees, Bitbucket, Jenkins, Cucumber, Git, JUnit, Jira etc.).
* Extensive experience with testing modern scripting language-based components.

Strong experience with automated testing and test-driven development
  
  

* Detailed understanding of smoke testing, functional, and non-black box testing, as well as regression testing
* Knowledge of software testing methodologies and techniques, including unit testing, integration testing, and functional testing
* Expert and hands on with backend test automation using Rest Assured/Karate for API testing. JDBC/JPA for database testing (Oracle/ DB2/ Snowflake).
* Experience in Software Development
* Proficiency in programming language (Java & Python)
* Knowledge of Databases and SQL preferred.
* Experience in writing sophisticated SQL queries.
* Experienced in Agile/Waterfall, onsite/offshore work model and coordination.
* Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Strong teamwork and collaboration skills.

title: Data Engineer
description:
**Meet the Team**
Join a high-performing team that is transforming the way Cisco delivers enterprise data, analytics, and AI-driven business solutions. Our organization builds next-generation platforms that power critical business capabilities across Sales, Customer Success, Services, Renewals, and Enterprise Agreements. We are at the forefront of leveraging Generative AI, Agentic AI, Machine Learning, and modern cloud technologies to automate complex workflows, accelerate engineering productivity, and deliver intelligent business insights at scale. As part of this team, you will shape Cisco's AI strategy by designing innovative solutions that solve real business challenges while influencing enterprise-wide technology adoption.
  
  
**Your Impact**
Join our team as a Data Engineer focused on modern data and AI solutions. This role offers the opportunity to work on high-impact platform modernization and AI initiatives from design through production.
  
  

* Build and optimize Snowflake and dbt data pipelines using advanced SQL and Python.
* Design and integrate enterprise data engineering and AI solutions, including LLM, RAG, and AI Agent use cases.
* Develop and manage complex system integrations and Control-M workflows across enterprise platforms.
* Partner with architects, engineers, and business stakeholders to deliver secure, scalable, and production-ready solutions.
* Contribute to platform modernization, data quality, automation, and AI innovation across the enterprise.

**Qualifications**
**Minimum Qualifications (Provide up to five (5) bullet points -**
*these should be clearly defined, objective, non-comparative, relevant, and quantifiable to appropriately evaluate applicants – not including soft skills*
**):**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* 3+ years of experience in data engineering, solution architecture, or enterprise application development, including 2+ years delivering AI/ML or Generative AI solutions.
* Hands-on experience developing data solutions using Snowflake, dbt, advanced SQL, and Python, including enterprise data pipelines and integrations.
* Experience with LLMs, Generative AI, RAG, or AI Agents, with exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Experience delivering enterprise-scale integrations and modernization initiatives, including APIs, Control-M, SAP HANA, SIT, data validation, and production deployment.

**Preferred Qualifications (Provide up to five (5) bullet points:**
these can include soft skills)
  
  

* Experience implementing Agentic AI, AI copilots, intelligent automation, or enterprise knowledge assistants using LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, or similar frameworks.
* Experience with enterprise data platforms including Snowflake, Databricks, dbt, Spark, vector databases, and data governance frameworks.
* Strong understanding of Responsible AI, AI security, governance, model evaluation, and enterprise compliance considerations.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate with technical and business leaders across cross-functional teams.
* Demonstrated innovation, continuous learning, and mentoring with the ability to drive AI solutions from proof of concept through production and enterprise adoption.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Package Consultant-Salesforce
description:
**Introduction**
A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
As a Salesforce Package Consultant, you will specialize in designing, implementing, and supporting Salesforce CRM solutions with LWC and integration experience. You will guide clients through the entire process, from business analysis to system configuration and user adoption, utilizing your expertise in Agile, Scrum, and Waterfall methodologies.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**

* Design and Implement Solutions: Develop tailored solutions to address clients' business needs by understanding their unique challenges and leveraging Salesforce's extensive offerings.
* Execute System Testing: Conduct system testing, user acceptance, and change management to ensure a successful implementation and long-term user adoption.
* Deliver Client-Facing Support: Provide expert guidance to clients throughout the entire process, from business analysis to system configuration and user adoption.
* Apply Methodologies: Utilize Agile, Scrum, and Waterfall methodologies to ensure a smooth software development lifecycle.
* Develop Training Programs: Create training programs to ensure successful user adoption and long-term usage of the implemented solutions.

**Preferred Education**
Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* Salesforce CRM Solutions Exposure: Experience working with Salesforce CRM solutions, including designing, implementing, and supporting solutions with LWC and integration experience.
* Agile Methodologies Application: Exposure to Agile, Scrum, and Waterfall methodologies, with the ability to apply them to ensure a smooth software development lifecycle.
* System Testing Execution: Experience executing system testing, user acceptance, and change management to ensure successful implementation and long-term user adoption.
* Business Analysis Understanding: Exposure to business analysis, with the ability to understand clients' unique challenges and develop tailored solutions to address their business needs.
* Software Development Lifecycle Management: Experience working within a software development lifecycle, with the ability to utilize methodologies to ensure smooth delivery.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Integration Experience: Exposure to integrating Salesforce CRM solutions with other systems, enhancing the ability to design and implement comprehensive solutions.
* Advanced LWC Knowledge: Experience working with Lightning Web Components (LWC), enabling the development of customized and efficient Salesforce solutions.
* Waterfall Methodology Familiarity: Exposure to Waterfall methodology, allowing for the application of this approach to ensure a smooth software development lifecycle.
